WORDS: Brighty! Where have you been?
I haven't seen you since NS stopped being depressed.
So you tried to take care of NS through non-physical means?
I appreciate your hatred for him, but being a coward isn't gonna work.
Next time, leave the plans to me.
Ah, so you're finally going to dish out that plan of turning me into one of those perfect forms.
I know what a perfect form is, just tell me how do I get mine?
I knew that name sounded familiar!
That's the same name I saw when I saw that post that assumed Chimney Boy and Chimney Girl wore diapers!
So, it was a rumor after all. They don't wear diapers after all.
Thanks for showing me, Starboy. I need to go now.
I don't think it will be.
OK. And who was the one who threw a watermelon at me just for helping their arch-enemy with a challenge?
Ok. So there's a new threat that's coming to Scratch Hood.
He's another ally of Erythros, but this one's different.
This one seems to be way less aggressive, wanting to ruin people's lives instead of killing them.
I don't know much about him, since when I read his information it just comes back as error codes.
But I know that his name is, Brighty.
You might not fully know him, but you will see eye-to-eye eventually.
And then, it will be a frenzy. Good luck.
